sections.title: Identity and observed environment
sections.intro: Record measured versions and the actual dependency state. Missing prerequisites are not failed objectives.

fields.label: Surname
fields.help: Your surname for the private assessment submission. Do not publish this completed form.

fields.label: Given name
fields.help: Your given name. Check the generated filename before saving.

fields.label: Group
fields.help: Your actual seminar group.

fields.label: Kit version or package ID
fields.help: Record C07 and S07 v1.1.0 or their PACKAGE_ID.txt values.

fields.label: Operating system
fields.help: Name the operating system and version actually used.

fields.label: Terminal and client used
fields.help: Name the terminal and HTTP client. Browser screenshots are optional, not a substitute for a reproducible command.

fields.label: Observed Node version
fields.help: Copy node --version or UNKNOWN: reason. The reference v24.21.0 is not a measurement.

fields.label: Observed npm version
fields.help: Copy npm --version or UNKNOWN: reason. The reference 11.19.0 is not a measurement.

fields.label: Actual project dependency and native-driver state
fields.help: Record preflight output and distinguish version resolution from loading sqlite3 and actually running Sequelize. Cite the original log.

sections.title: Prediction and starting state
sections.intro: Keep the original prediction. Use a fresh named fixture and separate the unsafe comparison from your implementation.

fields.label: Exact fixture and booking input
fields.help: Identify the fresh P02 seed, event, attendee and seats. Use returned IDs rather than guessing later generated IDs.

fields.label: Prediction recorded before execution
fields.help: Before execution predict availability, booking count and audit count for success and for a controlled failure. Never replace this prediction retrospectively.

fields.label: Booking invariant and its scope
fields.help: Name the facts which must agree and scope the invariant to the supplied fixture and operations. State what concurrency or crash behaviour is not covered.

fields.label: Allowed edit and diff summary
fields.help: Only projects/p02/src/book-seats.js. Record your diff summary; models, tests and locks are protected.

fields.label: Initial baseline/objective/regression status
fields.help: Copy the baseline/objective/regression results or the exact prerequisite block. A TypeError, timeout or native-load error is not an intended assertion failure.

fields.label: Initial inventory, bookings and audits
fields.help: Record the state before the call and name the command or witness. Source expectations must not be labelled as measured rows.

fields.label: Supplied unsafe comparison: actual result or pending
fields.help: Use the supplied unsafe comparator in a fresh fixture when possible. Record its actual partial state or PENDING with the reason.

fields.label: What the comparison does not establish
fields.help: Explain why this sequential counterexample is not a concurrency test or a qualified production design.

sections.title: Implementation and failure evidence
sections.intro: Record the command, evidence class and actual result. A module model is not SQL rollback.

fields.label: Observed sequence and awaited operations
fields.help: Identify the order of event lookup, duplicate lookup, event save, booking creation, callback and audit creation. Link the observer trace.

fields.label: Same transaction identity at all five database operations
fields.help: Account for all five database operations, including event.save, plus the callback. State whether one non-null transaction identity was observed and name the evidence class.

fields.label: Committed success state and returned values
fields.help: Give availability and actual booking/audit rows after success, plus the detached result. Distinguish the model from genuine ORM execution.

fields.label: HTTP status, Location and body or pending
fields.help: Record the actual POST status, Location and response body with its client command. The supplied application has no GET /api/bookings/:id route; do not invent one.

fields.label: Controlled callback failure: input and actual error
fields.help: Identify the controlled afterBookingCreated rejection, its origin and observed error. Label any injection.

fields.label: Controlled audit-create rejection: input and actual error
fields.help: Identify the separately injected BookingAudit.create rejection. This differs from throwing before the call.

fields.label: State before and after each failed attempt
fields.help: For each failed attempt record before and after availability, bookings and audits. A passing substitute is not physical rollback.

fields.label: Known outcomes and unexpected error identity
fields.help: Record preserved unexpected-error identity and known error codes. UniqueConstraintError alone does not identify the failing operation.

fields.label: Callback completion versus outer transaction settlement
fields.help: Separate callback completion from the returned transaction promise settling and the caller receiving a result. Label any delayed model gate as a model.

fields.label: Successful independent booking after a failed attempt
fields.help: After a controlled failed booking, record an independent successful booking on the same database instance and check all three state components.

sections.title: Evidence classes and interpretation
sections.intro: Name the scope of each observation and the checks that remain outstanding.

fields.label: Invalid, missing, sold-out and duplicate cases
fields.help: Record invalid seats, missing event, sold-out and duplicate outcomes with unchanged state. Source order checks sold-out before duplicate; do not reverse it.

fields.label: Environment and fixture identity of each witness
fields.help: Map evidence IDs to source fixture, runtime and commands. Label ACTUAL_ORM_SQLITE and LOCAL_HTTP only for genuine execution, MODULE_MODEL for substitutes and SOURCE_REASONING for reading.

fields.label: Actual ORM/HTTP evidence state
fields.help: ACTUAL_RECORDED means that you declare the actual required ORM and HTTP observations below. The form cannot authenticate them. An alternative needs separate teacher authority.

fields.label: Limits of the atomicity observation
fields.help: State exactly which sequential failure points were exercised. Do not claim crash durability, reversible external side effects or general transaction coverage.

fields.label: What was and was not tested about concurrent requests
fields.help: Name untested schedules and isolation assumptions. No new production mutex, lock policy or load experiment is required for P02.

fields.label: Checks not yet executed and reasons
fields.help: List unexecuted checks or NONE with a reason. Do not convert missing dependencies into a PASS.

sections.title: Bounded Gemini review
sections.intro: Use one sanitised claim and an independent witness. Agreement with Gemini is not the target.

fields.label: Actual Gemini activity state
fields.help: Use ACTUAL_RECORDED for an actual bounded interaction. Synthetic offline practice remains pending. Any alternative requires prior separate approval.

fields.label: Sanitised context and date
fields.help: State the small sanitised code or contract context. No passwords, tokens, cookies or private datasets.

fields.label: Relevant prompt only
fields.help: Copy only the relevant prompt, not the full conversation.

fields.label: One claim selected for verification
fields.help: Quote or accurately restate one claim selected for audit.

fields.label: Independent witness and evidence class
fields.help: Give an independent command, test, diff or exact contract passage and the observed result. Name its evidence class.

fields.label: ACCEPTED / REJECTED / PARTIALLY ACCEPTED / UNKNOWN
fields.help: Choose ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN on the evidence, not on confidence of wording.

fields.label: Correction or justified NONE
fields.help: Give the minimal correction or NONE with a justification.

fields.label: Limit of the verification
fields.help: State what your independent check does not establish.

sections.title: Required architecture decision record
sections.intro: Required analysis, not a second full programming project. About 300–500 words plus a small client-effect table is a suggested scope.

fields.label: Decision context and invariant
fields.help: Use a sanitised semester-project context. Where undecided, label a provisional course-domain decision and when it will be revisited.

fields.label: Resource identity and intended public representation
fields.help: Identify the resource and its stable identity. Distinguish registration membership from a booking POST operation.

fields.label: At least two realistic alternatives
fields.help: Compare at least two realistic alternatives, including action-shaped endpoints and a membership resource where relevant. Do not merely list names.

fields.label: Chosen design and reason
fields.help: Choose and justify an option against stated criteria. A rejected Gemini proposal can be a sound decision.

fields.label: Transaction boundary, reads, writes and failure policy
fields.help: Identify state that must change together, its owner, transaction membership and excluded side effects. Separate atomicity from concurrency and durability.

fields.label: Repeat-request effect and response table
fields.help: Use the P03 contract rows: collection GET; first member PUT; identical PUT; changed ticketType PUT; first DELETE; repeated DELETE; invalid query/body; missing parent. Add method/path, intended effect, expected response category, evidence class and remaining uncertainty. Discuss an uncertain response separately as a thought experiment unless actually observed.

fields.label: Source or experiment evidence supporting the decision
fields.help: Cite contract paths, observed witnesses or a declared source-based comparison. Full P03 implementation is not required for this analysis.

fields.label: Trade-offs and a condition for revisiting the decision
fields.help: Explain costs, operational limits and a condition for revisiting the decision. Do not assume Location is a retrievable endpoint in P02.

sections.title: Completion and individual declaration
sections.intro: Save a truthful draft at minute 60. Finish P02 and the ADR before the separately configured deadline.

fields.label: Actual state at minute60 and at final export
fields.help: At minute 60 record IMPLEMENTATION_PENDING, EVIDENCE_PENDING, ADR_PENDING or your actual state. The time limit does not produce a PASS.

fields.label: Next smallest unresolved check
fields.help: Name the smallest useful next check or NONE with a reason.

fields.label: Mechanism-based reflection
fields.help: Explain one mechanism and which observation changed or confirmed your view.

fields.label: Remaining uncertainty
fields.help: State one specific untested assumption or boundary, not a generic confidence claim.

fields.label: Separately obtained teacher decision, when applicable
fields.help: Write NONE for the standard route. For any separately approved alternative start AUTHORISATION: and give teacher, date, decision reference, exact affected requirement and replacement evidence. This field cannot grant approval.

fields.label: Truthful individual-work and evidence declaration
fields.help: I performed or accurately attributed the work, preserved predictions and distinguished measured, imported and synthetic evidence. No secrets or private third-party data are included.
